versions.content: Usage of SwAddrMethod in the context of a DataPrototype The software component which defines the DataPrototype will in general not be the same to which the Implementation that actually contains the description of the MemorySection belongs. The reason for this is that the resources for data allocated by the RTE will be described in the Implementation of the RTE. The indirection via SwAddrMethod makes this possible.
